div.div: سِفَآءٌ , accord. to the K, signifies A medicine, or remedy: [see 3, last signification:] but this requires consideration; for it is said in the M, [↓ السَّفَآءُ signifies unsteadiness, and levity; and IAar says,] السَّفَآءُ from السَّفِىُّ is like الضْلَرRَّقَآءُ from الضْلَرRَّقِىُّ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
